title: Joint Distribution Alignment for Universal Domain Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2608.24429v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) has been widely concerned in the fields of machine learning, pattern recognition, and computer vision. Traditional UDA learning usually assumes that the label spaces of the source and target domains are exactly the same and only needs to solve the problem of sample distribution drift existing between two domains. However, in real world applications, the label spaces between two domains may be different. In this case, there are both sample distribution drift and class spatial difference between domains, namely Universal Domain Adaptation (UniDA) learning scenario. At present, existing works rarely offer theoretical analysis for universal domain adaptation. In this paper, we provide an upper bound of the generalization error for universal domain adaptation. translated_title: 联合分布对齐用于通用域适应
translated_abstract: 无监督域适应（UDA）在机器学习、模式识别和计算机视觉领域受到广泛关注。传统的UDA学习通常假设源域和目标域的标签空间完全相同，只需解决两域之间存在的样本分布漂移问题。然而，在现实世界应用中，两域之间的标签空间可能不同。在这种情况下，域间既存在样本分布漂移，又存在类别空间差异，即通用域适应（UniDA）学习场景。目前，现有工作很少为通用域适应提供理论分析。在本文中，我们为通用域适应提供了一个泛化误差的上界。根据所提出的泛化误差界，我们提出了一种新颖的UniDA算法，称为通用域适应的联合分布对齐。
tldr: 本文首次为通用域适应提供了泛化误差上界，并基于此提出了一种联合分布对齐算法，以有效处理源域和目标域标签空间不一致时的分布漂移和类别差异问题。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first generalization error upper bound for universal domain adaptation and proposes a joint distribution alignment algorithm to effectively handle distribution drift and class space differences when label spaces between source and target domains are inconsistent.
